findings.description: Partially persisted stop projection could not resume after Release expiry. Exact prior signed historical Release may now be used only for stop/revoke delivery; active connection still requires currently valid Release. Tested lost-write resume, no lifecycle/credential effects, post-expiry revocation, rejected expired activation and rejected alternate historical release.

verifiedProperties: Recovery-only projector hardcodes connectRequested=false. Receiver recovery path skips execution-ledger initialization, credential creation and service reconciliation.
Cloud receiver independently pins releasePublicKey, prevents grant replacement and revoked-status/version rollback, and checks exact public/control readback before STORED.
Lost reply retries same signed envelope and revision; failed projections preserve durable intent and cannot report completed readback.

Stopped-v2 validator authenticates each distinct role, exact Release digest, runtime version, revision, epoch, review digest and corresponding results digest; it explicitly does not claim actual runtime stopped or deployment permission.
Actual-adapter integration executes real ProjectForge engine using temp SQLite and project directory, preserves and reconciles synthetic lost-reply result without redispatch.
Actual-chain test uses synthetic keys/Human approval and in-process transport; no production service sockets or genuine human identity admission.
Reviewed targeted tests inject in-memory receiver IO and lifecycle functions; no hidden production configuration or credential writes observed.
limits: 145-test full-suite evidence was read before four newly added expiry regressions; parent must refresh final integrated count.
This review does not approve production installation, production credentials, UNKNOWN settlement, business cutover or Owner retirement.
Production independently trusted Human enrollment, exact signed Release/handoff, verified single-writer transition, and real same-epoch runtime stop attestations remain unclosed gates.

Cloud signed configuration receiver remains a deployment component with privileged non-recovery functions; pass is for reviewed recovery branch and nonproduction PR, not permission to invoke production entry.
